name: BNB Rice Extract Bright & Glow Facial Kit | 3-in-1 Whitening, Brightening & Hydrating Skincare
description:
The BNB Rice Extract Bright & Glow Kit is a 3-in-1 skincare solution designed for girls and women seeking clear, radiant, and even-toned skin. Infused with rice extract, it cleanses, exfoliates, and hydrates while targeting dullness, pigmentation, and dark spots. Perfect for a gentle yet effective home facial routine.
Key Features
 Enriched with rice extract for natural glow
 3-step skincare: cleanse, scrub, and mask
 Helps reduce dullness, pigmentation, and dark spots
 Hydrates, softens, and brightens skin tone
 Suitable for all skin types, gentle formula
 Cruelty-free and ethically sourced ingredients
Ingredients / Materials
Rice extract, mild surfactants, natural exfoliants, hydrating agents, skin-brightening botanicals
How to Use
 Step 1: Apply Rice Facewash, gently massage, and rinse off
 Step 2: Use Rice Scrub in circular motions, then wash thoroughly
 Step 3: Apply Rice Face Mask evenly, leave for 10–15 minutes, then rinse
Package Includes
 1 × Rice Facewash
 1 × Rice Scrub
 1 × Rice Face Mask
